name: Ensemble Stars!
original_name: あんさんぶるスターズ！
source: Yumenosaki Academy is an all-boys high school that trains idols. The protagonist is the first student to be enrolled in the Producer Course. It's her duty to help manage the idols.
translation: 梦之咲学院，是一所培养偶像的男子高中。主角，是制作人科招收的第一名学生。协助管理偶像们，便是她的职责。
